verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents escalation policies that route alert notifications to on-call schedules, individual users, or Slack channels, and tracks whether alerts are acknowledged. The evidence never describes how unacknowledged pages move through ordered steps, timed delays, fallback responders, or repeat rounds. Missing for 10: documented multi-step escalation with configurable delays, fallback/next-step responders, repeat rounds until acknowledgement, independent or hands-on corroboration.
